This Monthly Refresher Webinar will be a Website Management Overview. This is an excellent webinar to attend for anyone who is currently managing an HCP compliance program and who wishes to brush up on their skills. It's also a good option for those who may have inherited responsibilities after their program was initially setup. There will be a live question and answer segment that we encourage you to participate in as well.
